_note: Finishers: when an enemy staggers (health at or below its staggerBelowFraction, see enemies.json), pressing ATK within 'range' px in front of it plays a finisher. Times in ms. The strike lands at strikeAtMs and kills the target. 'form' is which Abel can use it; 'targets' is 'any' or 'drainable' (Methuselah). 'buff' multiplies outgoing damage for durationMs; 'heal' restores health. The player is invulnerable for the whole finisher. 'weapon' (optional): only usable with that weapon (or one of a list) in hand (src/data/weapons.json).
